description.narrative:
We want to scope, design, and test alternative funding models to power up feminist futures. We want to understand under what conditions we can support more funding to reach feminist climate activists, organisers,and movements globally, including in the Netherlands.How: We need rethink Oxfam Novib's role as lead funder and connector, create new alliances, use methodologies to future proof our work using feminist futures and tools from the feminist influencing basket of resources
By fostering a healthier environment for funding feminist futures,this will help us to become the leading Dutch platform for equality and justice. This connects the dots withdifferent program goals and supports the implementation of Horizon 2, powering up our ability to supportchangemakers, movements and alliances, and helps us to act on our values.The activities of this PDF will include (1) track record development: Develop a track record of our feministclimate justice work (2) Mapping, scoping and relationship building: whichallies would want to be part of this.(3) Donor map: Map who funds this work and under what kind of conditions, models, approaches. (4) Proposea funding model that meets the current funding moment and future funding scenarios. (5) Convene funders,grassroots activists and feminist climate justice movements leaders. (6) Test approach: design a seed fund thatenables us to develop and test out what this looks like in practice

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
